evidence.semantic_review: Every current P |-- Q has a route from existing premises. The hard ring-update goals need proved helpers but no annotation/specification change.

natural_language_analysis.summary: Query witnesses unfold CircularAreaLogicalState and result predicates. Write dispatch witnesses choose the observed result, normalize free capacity, and split the two Z.min branches. Copy witnesses split mixed/full arrays at proved bounds. Return witnesses instantiate concrete wrap/non-wrap physical_after lists; force returns fold CircularAreaForceWriteResource, while non-force returns prove appended logical FIFO state. Error returns preserve the old backing resource.

witnesses.vc_shape: P preserves descriptor and has readidx<>writeidx plus logical state; Q adds FullResult 0 and preserves the same resource.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold the state full discriminator: unequal indices exclude full logical length; unfold FullResult and cancel resources.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has equal indices/status 0; Q preserves resources and returns FullResult 0.
witnesses.proof_route: The empty discriminator gives logical length 0; positive capacity makes the full-length equality false.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has equal indices and nonzero status; Q preserves resources and returns FullResult 1.
witnesses.proof_route: State restricts status to 0/1; nonzero selects 1 and the full discriminator gives logical length=capacity.

witnesses.vc_shape: P contains the logical state; Q is area_length<>0.
witnesses.proof_route: Extract 0<area_length from CircularAreaLogicalState.

witnesses.vc_shape: P bounds read/write indices below capacity<=256; Q bounds their difference in signed-int range.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold state and solve from 0<=indices<area_length<=256 and fixed INT_MIN/INT_MAX.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has FullResult retval and retval<>0; Q requires logical length=capacity and unchanged resources.
witnesses.proof_route: Choose the equality branch by unfolding FullResult; rewrite the circular_area alias and cancel resources.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has FullResult 0 and logical state; Q requires logical length<capacity and unchanged resources.
witnesses.proof_route: FullResult 0 excludes equality and state supplies length<=capacity.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is a non-full ring state; Q says the machine ring-distance expression equals logical length and preserves resources.
witnesses.proof_route: Normalize 32-bit casts with small bounds, then combine writeidx=(readidx+len) mod capacity and len<capacity.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has logical length=capacity; Q is DataLengthResult logical capacity with unchanged resources.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold DataLengthResult and use the premise directly.

witnesses.vc_shape: P says the normalized writeidx+d0 exceeds capacity; Q requires DivideWrDataResult result 1.
witnesses.proof_route: Normalize unsigned_last_nbits because 0<=writeidx+d0<=UINT_MAX and choose the greater-than result branch.

witnesses.vc_shape: P says the normalized writeidx+d0 is at most capacity; Q requires DivideWrDataResult result 0.
witnesses.proof_route: Use the same bounded unsigned normalization and choose the <= result branch.

witnesses.vc_shape: P contains post-copy segments and logical state; Q is area_length<>0.
witnesses.proof_route: Extract positive capacity from logical state.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has CircularAreaBackingResource plus full input; Q exposes the same descriptor/buffer and logical-state facts.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold BackingResource, rewrite parameter aliases, and cancel every field/buffer assertion.

witnesses.vc_shape: P observes FullResult retval with retval=0; Q existentially records the result and non-force admissibility.
witnesses.proof_route: Instantiate full_result:=retval; result 0 falsifies the veto and, with length<=capacity, gives non-full length.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has force0<>0 and an observed full result; Q existentially records it with branch admissibility.
witnesses.proof_route: Instantiate full_result:=retval; force0<>0 makes the non-force veto and implication immediate.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has requested>free and a nonzero divide result; Q needs ready actual=free and divide result 1.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode retval=logical length, normalize free, show Z.min chooses free, use non-force admissibility for positivity, and decode result<>0.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has requested<=free and a nonzero divide result; Q needs ready actual=requested and result 1.
witnesses.proof_route: Normalize free, show Z.min chooses requested, use requested>0 for non-force positivity, and decode result<>0.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has mixed_full/full input and wrap result 1; Q splits both arrays and records tail/down bounds and cast identities.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode the wrap inequality, derive 0<=capacity-writeidx<=actual, normalize casts, and split array predicates at the derived indices.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is after the first wrap memcpy; Q further splits the untouched prefix and remaining input.
witnesses.proof_route: Derive 0<=write_len_down<=writeidx; apply segment-split, sublist-app, and bounded-sublist-length lemmas.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has mixed_full/full input, selected free actual, and result 0; Q creates three backing and two input segments.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode writeidx+actual<=capacity, normalize free/readiness, and split backing/input at writeidx, writeidx+actual, and actual.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has actual=requested and result 0; Q creates the non-wrap segments and an empty input suffix.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode the <= branch, show min=requested, split backing/input, and normalize sublist requested requested to nil.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is the wrapped updated buffer with equal read/write fields and status 1; Q existentially requires ForceWriteEffect/Resource.
witnesses.proof_route: Choose actual=data_length, new_writeidx=write_len_down, and the concrete written-prefix++old-middle++written-tail physical list; prove extensional update and fold resource.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is the non-wrap updated buffer with equal read/write fields/status 1; Q requires ForceWriteEffect/Resource.
witnesses.proof_route: Choose the concrete old-prefix++written-middle++old-suffix physical list, prove non-wrap PhysicalWrite, merge segments, and fold force resource.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is wrapped updated storage under force=0; Q existentially requires WriteSuccess and canonical backing for logical++written-prefix.
witnesses.proof_route: Instantiate actual/data_length, modular new index, appended logical list, and concrete physical list; prove PhysicalWrite, LiveBytes extension, byte/length bounds, and state discriminators.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is non-wrap updated storage under force=0; Q requires WriteSuccess and canonical appended-FIFO backing.
witnesses.proof_route: Use the non-wrap concrete physical list and the same logical-state extension proof, then merge/fold the resource.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has force=0 and nonzero full result with unchanged storage; Q is full-length error and the old backing resource.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode FullResult nonzero, unfold ErrorResult, and fold BackingResource around unchanged fields/buffer.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has requested<=0 and requested>=0 with unchanged resources; Q is a disjunction including requested=0 error.
witnesses.proof_route: Choose the requested=0 disjunct, derive equality arithmetically, unfold ErrorResult, and cancel resources.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has null input and unchanged backing; Q is ErrorResult 1 and the same backing.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold ErrorResult and cancel the preserved resource.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has ca0=0 and GlobalStrings; Q is ErrorResult 1 with GlobalStrings.
witnesses.proof_route: Unfold ErrorResult and cancel GlobalStrings.

witnesses.vc_shape: P selected the free-capacity branch; Q needs free<=capacity and writeidx+free<=UINT_MAX.
witnesses.proof_route: Decode DataLengthResult, normalize capacity-length, and combine state length/index/capacity bounds.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has requested<=free capacity; Q needs requested<=capacity and writeidx+requested<=UINT_MAX.
witnesses.proof_route: Normalize free and combine requested<=free with state bounds.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has pre-first-copy wrap segments; Q asks expected sublist lengths for physical tail and input prefix.
witnesses.proof_route: Apply bounded sublist-length formulas using physical length=capacity, input length=requested, and tail<=data_length.

witnesses.vc_shape: P is between wrap copies; Q asks sublist lengths for the down prefix and input remainder.
witnesses.proof_route: Use 0<=write_len_down<=writeidx plus physical/input total lengths in bounded sublist lemmas.

witnesses.vc_shape: P has the non-wrap three-way split; Q asks written physical/input sublist lengths.
witnesses.proof_route: Apply bounded sublist-length formulas at writeidx..writeidx+actual and 0..actual.
